english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a boring thing or a person who feels bored, especially when the feeling is dullness or restlessness.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for feeling bored and restless.
Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for something boring, or for feeling bored and low.
This is the all-purpose choice for a film, book, activity, or event that fails to hold your attention.
This is the all-purpose choice when something is boring or wearisome, such as a long story.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when the work is tedious or boring rather than physically tiring.
Use 悶 as the all-purpose choice when something is boring or monotonous.
Use this when something is unattractive because it is boring or fails to hold your interest.
Use this colloquially when the repetitive thing is experienced as boring or tedious, not simply when it lacks variation.
Use it when an event or situation feels boring and lifeless.
